Failure mode: Input over-voltage: load dump above TVS clamp (unsuppressed 24 V systems 151-202 V)
Effect: TVS fails short -> fuse opens (safe) or FET/buck destroyed
Cause: Assumption 'centrally suppressed load dump 58 V' violated
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): TVS Vc 58.1 V @51.6 A inside LM74700 60 V rec./65 V abs window; FET 80 V; LM5164 100 V; fuse F1 clears TVS short
Detection / test: ISO 16750-2 load dump test A/B; TVS temperature rise
Residual risk & action before fab: MEDIUM. Local TVS cannot absorb unsuppressed 24 V load dump; requires vehicle central suppressor or larger TVS (e.g. SM8S36A) - documented assumption

Failure mode: BLE range loss (detuning, wrong ground/feed geometry)
Effect: Reduced range/PER at edge of cell
Cause: Plastic housing / metal nearby, PCB stackup differs from TI 1 mm 2-layer ref
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): TI SWRU120D geometry copied; ground/copper keepout 31 x 8 mm on all layers; pi-match footprints (ANT1-3) and 2 shorting-tab links R67/R68; 50 ohm 0.35 mm feed
Detection / test: VNA S11 in enclosure, OTA range test, TRP/TIS
Residual risk & action before fab: HIGH until measured: RF network values are TI reference starting points and topology is UNVERIFIED

Failure mode: Conducted emission from 300 kHz buck (AM band) above CISPR 25 limits
Cause: Switching harmonics, input filtering minimal
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Small hot loop, input caps at VIN pin, GND plane L2; footprint space for extra input filter (not populated)
Residual risk & action before fab: HIGH until tested: add LC/CM input filter if needed

Failure mode: Battery leakage / deep discharge while vehicle off
Cause: Standby drain from 3V3 buck + MCU + TCAN in reset; no cut-off
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Pack has PCM (UVLO); MCU can enter shutdown; TCAN held in RST; ITERM/TMR defaults
Detection / test: Measure sleep current on battery (target < 20 uA MCU + < 40 uA rails)
Residual risk & action before fab: MEDIUM: quiescent budget unmeasured (calculated only). Consider battery disconnect FET

Failure mode: Spurious emissions / harmonic (3rd) above limit
Cause: Filter values or layout deviate from reference; no RF shield
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): LPF footprint, keep-out around RF, solid GND on L2; option to add shield footprint (not implemented)
Detection / test: Conducted + radiated test at accredited lab
Residual risk & action before fab: MEDIUM: no compliance claimed. Shield footprint not provided

Failure mode: Metal or battery close to IFA (enclosure) detunes antenna
Cause: Enclosure assumptions violated (needs >5 mm clearance, plastic)
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Enclosure assumption documented in README; battery mounted away from antenna region
Residual risk & action before fab: Medium

Failure mode: Regulator thermal stress at 36-58 V / 125 C ambient
Cause: Ploss ~0.25 W (est.), RthJA 43 C/W + copper
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Thermal pad with 4-via array to GND planes, load << 1 A rating; Tj limit 150 C
Detection / test: IR camera / thermocouple at 85 C, 36 V, full load; TJ calc in POWER_BUDGET
Residual risk & action before fab: Medium: thermal performance calculated only (not simulated/measured)

Failure mode: Improper charging outside temperature window / wrong chemistry
Cause: NTC missing/wrong pack; LiFePO4 pack fitted; hot cabin >45 C
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): TS pin monitors pack NTC (10k 103AT-2); charge current limited 100 mA; safety timers on; keyed JST PH; R28 (10k) DNP unless no-NTC pack
Detection / test: Bench: cold/hot chamber with pack simulator, TS thresholds
Residual risk & action before fab: MEDIUM: pack chemistry restricted to 1S Li-ion 4.2 V; charging must not be used <0 C or >45 C without validation

Failure mode: Open bus, missing or double termination
Effect: Signal reflections, CAN FD errors at 5 Mbps
Cause: Node used as bus tap but JP1/JP2 closed (or end-node open)
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Termination optional by solder jumpers JP1/JP2 (default open); split termination for CM noise; stub length < 30 cm assumed
Detection / test: Bus impedance measurement 60 R, eye diagram
Residual risk & action before fab: Medium: documented default 'tap node' - user must set jumpers per installation

Failure mode: Input under-voltage during crank (<7 V) -> converter stops
Effect: V6P0 collapses; CAN goes off, MCU continues on battery
Cause: 12 V crank down to 3-6 V (ISO 16750-2 starting profile)
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): EN/UVLO 7.5/7.0 V by R10/R11; BQ24074 seamless OUT switch to battery; bulk 33 uF
Detection / test: Starting profile test, log CAN bus-off events
Residual risk & action before fab: Accepted behaviour; firmware must handle CAN re-init after brown-out

Failure mode: Solder-joint fatigue (thermal cycling -40..85 C, vibration)
Cause: Large 1210 MLCCs and SMC TVS, CTE mismatch
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Standard 1.6 mm FR-4; MLCC orientation/fillets; consider flexible-termination caps
Residual risk & action before fab: Medium: not tested

Failure mode: CAN traffic overload / watchdog
Cause: SPI latency vs BLE stack
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): TCAN M_CAN FIFO + nINT; RST/GPO watchdog options
Residual risk & action before fab: Low

Failure mode: Fuse nuisance-opens at cold crank / TVS conduction, or fails to protect
Cause: I2t mismatch vs 58 V TVS surge; 125 V rating OK
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): 1 A very-fast NANO2 with 300 mA typ load (<25% derating at 85C); footprint allows 2 A option
Residual risk & action before fab: Medium: fuse selection non-AEC-Q200 in BOM; confirm AEC-Q200 fuse family

Failure mode: Wrong battery insertion (reversed / wrong pack voltage)
Effect: Reverse voltage on BAT pin -> charger damage
Cause: Non-keyed alternative connector used
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Keyed JST PH pins 1/2/3 (BAT+/NTC/GND) fixed pinout
Residual risk & action before fab: Medium: no reverse-protection FET on BAT (cost/space) - add if pack polarity cannot be guaranteed

Failure mode: CAN bus short to battery / ground / other line
Cause: Harness fault
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): TCAN4550 bus pins +/-58 V rated with fault protection; PESD2CAN + ACT45B at connector; series link R40/R41
Residual risk & action before fab: Low-Medium; transient tests to be performed

Failure mode: ESD damage / immunity failure at connector (8 kV contact, 15 kV air)
Cause: Discharge to shield/CAN pins
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): TCAN HBM 15 kV bus pins; external PESD2CAN (30 kV) first at connector, CMC second; ground pour and short return
Residual risk & action before fab: Low-Medium; not yet tested

Failure mode: Poor solderability / tombstoning / voiding under thermal pads
Cause: 0402 with unequal pads, EP paste coverage
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Stock IPC footprints; EP via array (0.3 mm) should be plugged/tented; fiducials FID1-3
Residual risk & action before fab: Medium: via-in-pad plugging to be specified to assembler

Failure mode: Over-voltage on MCU DIO19 (VDDS+0.3 V max)
Cause: TCAN nWKRQ defaults to internal 3.6 V rail
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): R48 1 k series resistor; firmware sets 16'h0800[19]=1 to VIO domain at boot
Residual risk & action before fab: Low; firmware dependency documented

Failure mode: Wrong connector insertion / mis-mating / vibration fretting
Cause: Non-keyed mate, cable strain
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Micro-Fit polarised housing; pin pairing keeps VBAT/GND adjacent; mounting holes near connector
Residual risk & action before fab: Medium: automotive-grade connector (MX150/MQS) recommended for production

Failure mode: Reverse battery connection (12 V system: -14 V, jump-start swap; 24 V: -28 V)
Effect: Reverse current destroys regulators / harness fire
Cause: Harness miswire, jump-start error
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): SMDJ36CA bidirectional TVS does not conduct to -36 V; LM74700-Q1 keeps BUK7Y41-80E off (body diode blocks); fuse F1 upstream
Detection / test: Bench: apply -36 V current-limited, verify <1 mA reverse
Residual risk & action before fab: Low. Validate ISO 7637 pulse 1 and reverse-battery test (ISO 16750-2 4.7) - NOT yet performed

Failure mode: 3V3 rail droops / regulator drop-out at low battery
Effect: MCU brown-out reset; TCAN VIO below 3.135 V
Cause: Battery <3.4 V (100% mode)
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): TCAN kept in reset when VBATSYS<3.4 V (firmware), VDDS range 1.71-3.8 V
Residual risk & action before fab: Low

Failure mode: SPI signal-integrity errors (8 MHz+, ringing)
Cause: Long/unmatched routing, no series R
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Short routes, common 3.3 V domain (no level shifter), spare series-R option (0R footprints not fitted)
Residual risk & action before fab: Low

Failure mode: Crystal fails to start / wrong load capacitance
Effect: No CAN clock; SPI ok but no bus activity
Cause: CL/ESR mismatch; R52 series value assumed
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): ESR <=60 R crystal spec; 12 pF C0G load caps and 100 R series R52 footprints tunable; clock tolerance 0.5 % allowed by TCAN
Detection / test: Read TCAN DEVICE ID + CLK status register at bring-up, scope OSC
Residual risk & action before fab: Medium: values ASSUMED (TI 'TCAN455x clock guideline' not obtained)

Failure mode: Gate over-voltage or FET failed short (no reverse block)
Cause: LM74700 GATE-ANODE >15 V, FET VGS rating
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Standard-level FET (VGS +/-20 V) chosen over logic-level (VGS 10 V) - BUK7Y41-80E; VCAP cap per datasheet
Residual risk & action before fab: Low

Failure mode: HFXT start-up failure / frequency error
Cause: Wrong package footprint (2016 assumed), load cap array
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Tai-Saw TZ3908AAAO43 validated by TI, internal cap array, DNP C59/C60 for tuning
Detection / test: HFXT frequency measurement via DIO19 clock-out (SWRA834A 6.4)
Residual risk & action before fab: Medium: crystal package dimension to confirm with vendor drawing

Failure mode: Firmware/bootloader locks debug or wrong SPI mux
Cause: SPI0 mux (SCLK m1, CSN m1, POCI m1, PICO m2) misconfigured
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Pin mux table on schematic notes; ROM bootloader UART pins intentionally unused (SWD is the programming path)
Residual risk & action before fab: Low

Failure mode: Tombstone / misplacement due to oversize footprints (SMC, XGL6060)
Cause: Land pattern mismatch (XGL6060 uses XAL6060 footprint)
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): Vendor land patterns to be verified before release
Residual risk & action before fab: Low-Medium

Failure mode: Inductor saturation at cold/hot or current-limit event
Cause: Isat 2.5 A (20% drop) vs ILIM 1.75 A max
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): XGL6060-473MEC AEC-Q200, Isat margin >40% vs IPEAK max
Residual risk & action before fab: Low; land pattern shared with XAL6060 must be verified

Failure mode: Insufficient test points for bring-up / production test
Cause: Dense layout
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): 28 TPs on rails, CAN, SPI, RST, SWD; two PCB antenna test links
Residual risk & action before fab: Low

Failure mode: LFXT failure
Cause: Load caps / parasitics
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): 15 pF + 15 pF per TI reference; RCOSC fallback in firmware
Residual risk & action before fab: Low

Failure mode: SWD access blocked (pin reuse, RSTN pull-up), or bricked device
Cause: DIO16/17 are SWD by default; CCFG misconfig
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): J2 Cortex-Debug 10-pin, dedicated SWDIO/SWDCK, RSTN pulled up 100 k, test pads TP15-TP19
Residual risk & action before fab: Low

Failure mode: Thermal shutdown with VCCOUT loaded (TCAN datasheet Fig 9-8)
Cause: High VSUP with 70 mA load at 125 C
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): VSUP fed from 6.0 V (1 V LDO drop), VCCOUT unloaded (10 uF only)
Residual risk & action before fab: Low

Failure mode: MCU leaves RST floating/high at boot -> TCAN held in reset
Cause: Confusing polarity (active-HIGH pulse)
Design mitigation (schematic / layout): R47 100 k pull-down + MCU-controlled DIO18; polarity noted on schematic
Residual risk & action before fab: Low
